text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I thought I was gonna blow by everyone
and take
the win!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Trainer. I didn't mean to look so
lame in
front of you...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Trainer. I didn't mean to look so
lame in
front of you...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm upset that I lost, but draggin' the
loss along
with me isn't very cool.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If I've got time to complain, I've got time
to train!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... You'll train with me once we
get back,
right? I need to polish my
technique... and my
coolness!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Geez, you're not mincing words today.
Guess
that's why you're my trainer!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Of course it's not endin' like this! If
anything, this
loss is just gettin' my
engine heated up!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Of course I can! Your expectations, my

regrets—they're all just fuel in the tank!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Just you wait—next race, I'll show you
just how
cool I can really be!
